description: convert_pipe_run with replace moves the supports of the legacy pipe onto the run. A DN100 legacy pipe (0,0,1500), (2000,10,1500), (4000,0,1500) with three shoes at x 1000, 2000 and 3000. The vertex bends 2 x atan(10 / 2000) = 0.5729 deg, within the 1 deg elbow tolerance, so it merges: the run is the line y = 0 and the merged vertex was 10 mm off it. The shoes sit on the legacy legs at y 5, 10 and 5 and move 5, 10 and 5 mm onto the run (limit: one outside diameter, 114.3 mm); the legacy pipe is deleted and the supports now belong to the run.
